text:
nora: Heads-up: We're doing a two-step FF rollout for model-routing v4.2.2 tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. Sequence: pin service -> enable FF at 3% canary -> observe 10m -> enlarge to 25% -> manual approval -> 70%. Ops will keep an emergency pin command handy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary at 02:03 UTC. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 4m OR p95 latency > 1.8x baseline 4m. Runbook ref: https://go/runbooks/route-v4-cutover

josh: Metrics to watch: route-errors-5xx, p95-latency-regional, model-cache-fill. Alerts already in #incidents and pager on-call.

li: please add a 15m hold after 25% for evaluation. We've hit slow regressions in similar ramps.

nora: added 15m hold after 25%. We'll require manual ack in-thread before proceeding to 70%.

ops-bot: Preflight checks: 
 - instance health ok
 - DB connections within normal
 - cache warming >= 75%
(preflight ok)

deploy-bot: FF commands prepared: 
```
# step 1: 3% canary
ffctl apply --flag route_v4_experiment --percent 3 --cohorts canary --meta deploy_id=6843210000
# step 2: 25%
ffctl apply --flag route_v4_experiment --percent 25 --meta ff_wave=2
```

josh: Make sure logs include `deploy_id=6843210000` and `ff_wave` tags so we can filter traces.

nora: Agreed. Also, release-bot will append a release note stub automatically after the final approval.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:03 UTC (route_v4_experiment=3%). Collecting traces and eval snapshots.

josh: quick smoke at 02:06 shows no increase in 5xx; small latency bump (+8%) but within expected.

li: holding. Will run targeted evals at 25%.

(02:25) li: 25% hold results: QA evals within margin, cache warm looks good. Recommending proceed to manual approval.

nora: manual approval granted to proceed to 70%. Note: if any user-facing regressions hit support, we revert immediately.

deploy-bot: Initiating 70% ramp at 02:28 UTC. Monitoring for auto-deadman.

ops-bot: Emergency rollback commands: 
```
ffctl apply --flag route_v4_experiment --percent 0 --force --meta reason=rollback
routectl pin --service routing --version v4.2.1 --meta restored_by=ops
```

release-bot: Reminder: include the following in release notes: deploy_id=6843210000, ff_approach=two-step, hold_durations=15m, rollback_criteria=5xx>0.4%|p95>1.8x.

nora: All good. I'll post the final release note once successful. Thanks everyone. :tada:
